messages:
olivia: Heads-up — noticed a repro where switching KV cache to INT8 + aggressive slot coalescing drops top-1 generation quality ~3.5% on our longctx test (32k tokens). Memory savings look great but accuracy regression is real. attaching quick profile in thread. Anyone seen this pattern?

chen: ugh. can you paste the exact flags/repro? is this on dedicated or local dev rig?

olivia: repro on local dev GPU (A10G). flags: `--kv-mode=int8 --slot-coalesce=aggressive --warmup-policy=prefix`

sam: repro command I used:```bash
python -m rdinfer.bench longctx_repro \
  --model redwood-open/7B-int8 \
  --tokens 32000 \
  --kv-mode int8 \
  --slot-coalesce aggressive \
  --seed 42 
```

maya: quick profiler snapshot (truncated):```text
kernel_select: fallback GEMM_generic for attn_kv_update (sequence>2048)
kv_eviction: page_move xfer 78ms, compaction 120ms
kv_warmup: 1.3s per prefix for cold slots
```

ryan: interesting — kernel fallback means we lost optimized tiled kernels for long sequence shapes. that + quant noise could explain quality hit. did int8 quantize scales per-slot or global?

olivia: per-slot scales. we tried global as well — still ~2.1% drop (less worse).

perf-bot: perf summary: peak RSS -20% vs bf16, token p95 latency +12%, kv-evict ops increased 2.8x under aggressive coalesce.

chen: can you dump a small eval diff? a couple failing examples to check if it's systematic or certain tokens?

olivia: pasted two diffs inline (short):
- expected: "The patient reported no side effects..."
- int8:    "The patient reported some side effects..."
- expected: "Initialize the kernel using..."
- int8:    "Initialize kernel using..." (minor punctuation)
seems distributional, not catastrophic but consistent semantic shift on some prompts.

maya: hypothesis: slot coalesce merges KV entries with different dynamic ranges; per-slot scales cause quantization mismatch when slots are reused across shifted contexts. compaction/paging may reorder pages and reuse aged scales.

ryan: actionable: try (1) disable aggressive coalesce, (2) switch to per-buffer shared scale (hybrid), (3) increase warmup prefix to re-calibrate caches. also check kernel selector: force tiled kernel for attn_kv_update to ensure numeric stability.

sam: ran quick A/B: disabling coalesce -> quality back to baseline, memory +12% vs aggressive int8 but still -10% vs bf16. switching to shared-scale per-buffer -> reduced accuracy gap to ~0.9% and cut compaction ops by ~40%.

infra-bot: deploy pipeline for experiment branch `kv/int8-hybrid-scale` queued (build 2841).

chen: nice. let's add unit test that simulates slot reuse with mixed ranges (sine + random) and assert no >1.0% regressed logprob on our evalset. also add a telemetry counter for "scale-mismatch-events" when we reuse a slot whose previous scale differs >x%.

perf-bot: note: kernel selector trace shows heuristics pick generic GEMM when seq_len>2048 and batch<4. we should consider kernel tiling fallback threshold adjustments for int8 path.

olivia: agreed. Action items: 1) Sam to land hybrid-scale experiment and perf run (A/B), 2) Chen to add unit/telemetry, 3) Ryan to tune kernel selector thresholds for tiled kernels on longctx, 4) Maya to validate compaction ordering preserves scale annotations. I'll collate data and ping infra when we need wider runs. :thumbsup: 

ryan: I'll also add a fast path in selector: if kv_mode==int8 && slot_reuse_rate>50% -> prefer tiled kernels even if batch small. quick sim locally shows ~4-6% p95 latency diff but improves logprob stability.

sam: pushing branch now, will post CI perf numbers in a few hours.

olivia: thanks team. keeping this thread for follow-ups. if anyone hits similar regressions label with `kv-int8-regress` and add seed + prompt.

infra-bot: experiment builds completed for `kv/int8-hybrid-scale`: builds 2841/2842 (small/large).
